clue.text: One of twelve walls in solid interior for stone statue

indicators.note: walls means surrounds, so the month is wrapped round the next piece

parts.note: a month is one of the twelve in a year

indicators.note: interior asks for the inside letters of solid, its ends dropped

explanation.surface: A stone statue is described as sitting in a solid courtyard walled for one month of the year.
explanation.definitionFit: A monolith is a single great block of stone, often raised as a monument or carved figure.

clue.text: Dog without lead finding some balls

indicators.note: without lead means the first letter of the dog's name is dropped

parts.note: Rover is the classic name for a pet dog, used in crosswords for any dog

explanation.surface: A dog off its lead runs off and turns up a few lost balls.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an OVER is a set of six balls bowled from one end, hence 'some balls'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket term: a set of six deliveries by one bowler counts as one over.

clue.text: See 10
As bottom delightful, bottom pinched

parts.note: arse is British slang for the bottom

indicators.note: bottom pinched means the last letter of the word for delightful is removed

parts.note: nice means delightful

explanation.surface: Someone admires a delightful bottom and gives it a cheeky pinch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As' is not a link word but the definition: As is the chemical symbol for this element.
explanation.definitionFit: As is the chemical symbol of the poisonous element number 33.

clue.text: Small spider, perhaps — one with spidery writing?

parts.note: a spider is an example of a creepy crawler

explanation.surface: A tiny spider wonders if it is the culprit behind some spidery handwriting.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who scrawls writes in a messy, straggling hand, like spider tracks.

clue.text: Name etched into a bracelet, possibly for a portable box

indicators.note: etched into means put inside, so the letter for name goes within the rearranged letters
possibly signals that the letters of a bracelet may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A name is engraved on a bracelet, perhaps to be kept in a little portable case.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabernacle was the portable sanctuary of the Israelites, and is also the ornamental box holding the Eucharist.

clue.text: I like, regularly, to embrace God

indicators.note: to embrace means the alternate letters wrap round the god's name
regularly asks for every other letter of the word like, here the second and fourth

parts.note: Odin is the chief god of Norse mythology

explanation.surface: Someone confides that they regularly like to embrace God.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I' at the start looks like the speaker but it is the definition: I is this element's chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: I is the chemical symbol of the element number 53, used as an antiseptic.

clue.text: Carrier pigeon finally into niche house contracts

indicators.note: into means the last letter of pigeon goes inside the word for niche

parts.note: a cove is a sheltered recess or nook, a niche

indicators.note: finally asks for the last letter of pigeon
contracts means the word for house is shortened by its last letter

parts.note: York is a royal house of England

explanation.surface: A homing pigeon flies into a nook as a house signs its contracts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carrier pigeon' reads as one phrase, but 'Carrier' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A conveyor is something that carries or transports goods from one place to another.

clue.text: Chapter requiring material for children's writer

parts.note: rayon is a synthetic fabric, a material

explanation.surface: A chapter of a children's book needs some fabric for the illustrator's work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'children's writer' suggests an author; it is something a child writes with.
explanation.definitionFit: A crayon is a wax colouring stick, the writing tool of young children.

definitions.meaning: the solution to the clues 15 and 17 is a big off-road car, an example of the type

explanation.walkthrough: The clue is just numbers: four multiplied by four makes 16, and 15 17 is a nickname for a large off-roader.
explanation.definitionFit: Four times four equals sixteen, and a large four-wheel-drive vehicle is nicknamed this way.

clue.text: Attention-seeker squeezing soft rubber article for entertainment in Italy

indicators.note: squeezing means the shout wraps round the next pieces

parts.note: oi is the shout used to grab someone's attention
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning soft
an eraser is a rubber for pencil marks
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A show-off squashes a soft rubber object to entertain an audience in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Opera seria is the serious, heroic form of Italian opera of the eighteenth century.

clue.text: One calling for a double

definitions.meaning: someone who rings a bell or phone is one who calls
a dead ... is someone's exact double or lookalike

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who rings is a caller, and a lookalike is called a dead ringer.

clue.text: California waters where ancient weapon taken in case of grenade

indicators.note: taken in means held inside the outer letters
case of asks for the outside letters of grenade, first and last

parts.note: olden means of former times, ancient
gat is old slang for a gun

explanation.surface: Somewhere in Californian waters an old weapon has turned up inside a grenade casing.
explanation.definitionFit: The strait linking San Francisco Bay to the Pacific Ocean is known by this name.

clue.text: I speak ill of Sicilian, perhaps

parts.note: to slander is to speak ill of someone

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to badmouthing a Sicilian.
explanation.definitionFit: A Sicilian lives on the island of Sicily, so is an example of an island dweller.

clue.text: Car twice the size primarily let loose round the back of Portobello?

definitions.text: Car twice the size primarily let loose round the back of Portobello?

indicators.note: round means the rearranged letters go around the last letter of Portobello
loose means the collected letters are set free and rearranged
twice means the word car is used two times

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: primarily asks for the first letter of size

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: back of asks for the final letter of Portobello

explanation.surface: An oversized car runs wild through the Portobello Road area of west London.
explanation.walkthrough: Portobello Road is in posh Notting Hill, near Chelsea, a wealthy London district where such big cars are mocked.
explanation.definitionFit: British jibe for a big four-wheel drive driven around wealthy city streets, never off-road.

clue.text: Nations spending the same money, Continental road to climb, critical stuff going over our heads?

indicators.note: to climb in a down entry means the word for road is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: rue is French for street, a road on the Continent

parts.words: critical stuff going over our heads?
parts.note: the ozone layer high above us is vital protection

explanation.surface: Countries sharing a currency look at a Continental road while vital matters pass over their heads.
explanation.definitionFit: The group of European Union countries sharing the euro as one currency.

clue.text: See 15
Dismissed, then sure to be leaving

parts.note: a batsman dismissed in cricket is out
bound means certain, as in bound to happen

explanation.surface: A batsman is sent off and is certain to be heading home.
explanation.definitionFit: Outbound describes travel heading away from a place, departing.

clue.text: Witch sees Liberal couple possessed by virtual witch

indicators.note: possessed by means the two letters sit inside the shortened witch
virtual means almost, so the witch's name loses its last letter

parts.note: Hecate is the Greek goddess of witchcraft

indicators.note: couple means two copies of the letter for Liberal

explanation.surface: A witch spots a Liberal couple under the spell of a near-witch.
explanation.definitionFit: A hellcat is a spiteful, fiery woman, also used for a witch or hag.

clue.text: So there's misshapen toe in brogue — try this?

indicators.note: misshapen means the letters of so there are pushed out of shape

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

indicators.note: the toe of a shoe is its end, so this asks for the last letter of brogue

explanation.surface: Someone recommends a remedy for a toe squashed out of shape inside a brogue.
explanation.walkthrough: A brogue is a sturdy British leather shoe with decorative perforations.
explanation.definitionFit: A shaped insert put into a shoe to keep its form, so worth a try for a misshapen toe.

clue.text: Frost a 23? Don't trust him!

annotationWithheld.why: Frost a 23? Don't trust him! — XE (a gas, from 23 GAS GUZZLER) sits inside HOAR (Frost) but no clue word signals the container

clue.text: Quite pleasing

definitions.meaning: as in fairly or rather good

explanation.definitionFit: As an adverb it means fairly or rather; as an adjective, attractive or nice.

clue.text: One into social balance

indicators.note: into means the numeral goes inside the word for social

parts.note: a social is a party or gathering
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone joins a social gathering to restore some balance.
explanation.definitionFit: Parity is equality or balance between two things.

clue.text: Joke about second crossword solver not starting 10 3

indicators.note: about means the joke wraps round the letter for second

parts.note: a gag is a joke

indicators.note: not starting means the first letter of the solver is dropped

parts.note: a puzzler is someone who solves puzzles such as crosswords

explanation.surface: A joke goes round about a crossword solver who never gets started.
explanation.definitionFit: A large off-road vehicle is criticised for drinking fuel heavily.

clue.text: Means by which money returned

indicators.note: returned means the word for money is read backwards

parts.note: loot is slang for money

explanation.surface: A thief explains how the money came back.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool is an instrument or means of achieving something.

clue.text: Skirt or tie, loosely speaking

indicators.note: loosely speaking means the score as said out loud gives the letters

parts.note: a tie is a drawn score such as two-two

explanation.surface: Someone choosing between a skirt and a necktie for an informal outing.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutu is the short stiff frilled skirt worn by ballerinas.

clue.text: Unit of force went off and on

indicators.note: off means the letters of went go wrong and are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A force unit switched off and then on again.
explanation.definitionFit: The newton is the SI unit of force, named after Sir Isaac.

clue.text: At sea, Titan at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters of sea and Titan are jumbled

explanation.surface: A giant Titan out on the ocean, at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'At' looks like a preposition; it is the chemical symbol of this element.
explanation.definitionFit: At is the chemical symbol of the rare radioactive element number 85.
